newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - July 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Philippine newspapers - July 7.

text.p: These are the leading stories in Manila newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Senato Leticia Ramos-Shahani and presidential advisor on economis affairs Lito Osmena joined forces for next year's presidential election (ALL NEWSPAPERS)

- Ten more Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) guerrillas were reported killed as fighting raged anew yesterday in two North Cotabato towns, raising to 20 the death toll in the fierce fighting that started Saturday morning. (STAR/BULLETIN)
- The Cambodian capital was rocked by heavy fighting for a second day on Sunday as forces under Second Prime Minister Hun Sen tightened their grip on the city. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)

- Central Bank governor Gabriel Singson assured bankers over the weekend there would be no change in an existing circular allowing banks to engage in derivatives activities, especially forward transactions. (JOURNAL)

- Executives of General Motors and Board of Investments officials scheduled a series of meetings starting tomorrow to discuss the investment plans in the Philippines of the American car giant.(Journal-Malaya )
- The stock market is seen to consolidate further this week amid a regime of high interest rates triggered by the spillover effects of the currency turmoil in Thailand.(Chronicle)
